exposure: vaginal colonization of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing bacteria
outcome: preterm premature rupture of the membranes (pPROM)
cohort: 13 pregnant women identified with a vaginal colonization of ESBL-producing bacteria from 2011 to 2016 at the Medical University of Vienna, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology
finding: Maternal colonization of ESBL-producing bacteria during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and pPROM.
